card.name: Digit after section number 8. (pregnancy)
card.fires_on: The digit 1 after "8." in section cross-references following fetal-harm warnings, and the digit 2 in "release 3.2" of Linux man-pages. Also a few stray words after "read the" or at the start of an email apology.

modes.label: Pregnancy section reference
modes.description: The digit 1 in a cross-reference such as 8.1 after a warning about fetal harm.
modes.example: Advise of potential risk to a fetus and use of effective contraception. ( 5.8 , 8.<<1>> , 8.3 )

modes.label: Man-pages release number
modes.description: The digit after "release 3." in the Linux man-pages colophon.
modes.example: COLOPHON This page is part of release 3.<<2>>7 of the Linux man-pages project.

modes.label: Stray word cases
modes.description: Occasional words that start an apology or follow "read the".
modes.example: (To help fight spam, this address might change occasionally.)<< Reg>>rettably, I can't reply to

card.writes: Promoted tokens are unrelated; it suppresses forms of the word read, so it adds no clear meaning.
card.plain: It lights up on the number 1 in a pregnancy-section cross-reference like 8.1, and on version digits in man-page footers.
